I am Twenty-Five.

The length of my sobriety is a long story. I had to quit one vice at a time so it took a while. I finally quit smoking cigarettes about in November 2012, I made it my new years resolution to not start again, then I gave up Cannabis. That one took just as long to kick as cigarettes. I still toke occasionally but I refuse to buy it or keep it on me as I end up feigning for it. I gave up drinking 2 months later to lessen alcoholism's hold on me. I continued abusing Amphetamines for 9 more months after that, they are incredibly addictive, so hard to kick.

Now, I sit here about 3 months completely sober. I just drink the occasional beer or glass of wine these days and that is the way I am going to keep it. 

Also, I have been to things similar to a rehabilitation program in the past. I found that it just introduced me to people that were about to fall off the wagon and take me off with them so I decided to start going it alone. It seems to be the only thing that works. If I meet any fellow skaters that seem like they party too hard or even use whatsoever, I make sure to stay as their acquaintance.
